items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Big Cornie? Did you ever work with him? [INTERVIEWEE] Big Cornie? ... [INTERVIEWER] ... No. No. I don't work with him.

ctx.x: What about Big Cornie? Did you ever work with him?
Big Cornish. You know the trombone player? No. No. I don't work with him. Willie Cornish? What about Frankie Deucon?
